title: Jaws
synopsis: A beach town, a Fourth of July, a chief who hates water, and a great white shark with a long memory.

nodes.text: The tank explodes and the shark goes red and the chief, who hates the water, paddles back to shore on debris with a friend at his side.
You bury Quint at sea and you do not, in your old age, talk about him to anyone, because the right words do not exist for a man who liked sharks more than he liked people.
Vaughn loses his job and the beach is closed for a season and the town rebuilds, this time with a new sign at the dock that says read the water.
